checks.name: A COMPLETED job that nothing was watching, read rather than trusted
checks.command: nebius ai job get/logs for aijob-e00y2hqz6349cb8aa2; read the locally captured logs/voxcraft-p4.log
checks.result: The job ran on the project's OWN pinned image nvcr.io/nvidia/cuda:10.2-devel-ubuntu18.04, reported state COMPLETED, and printed PROBE-VERDICT=BUILT with exit 0 - directly below 'make: *** [all] Error 2' in the same log. Reading the log: rc=2 at line 219 is the make failure, rc=0 at line 319 is a later command's status assigned over it, and the verdict is computed from the second. The build FAILED. The authoring agent never recorded this attempt: voxcraft-probe.json holds attempts 1-3 with any_attempt_built false. The page had said the pinned route was untried; it was tried and it failed, and both that correction and the false verdict are now in not_claimed. The page's conclusion is unchanged and better evidenced: two toolkits, two distinct failures, no cross-engine comparison offered.

checks.name: Non-finite literals absent from every published file
checks.command: regex scan plus a strict json.loads that rejects NaN/Infinity, with a planted positive control
checks.result: No NaN or Infinity in any results/*/*.json or in site/data/snapshot.json; the live snapshot passes a strict parse, so JSON.parse cannot throw in a visitor's browser. Detector proven by a planted {"a": NaN} which it catches and which strict parsing rejects. Run because a NaN-truthiness bug was found in an unpublished design space's own guard.

checks.name: Absence-claims checked against the domain that backs them
checks.command: pattern scan over live design-space data with positive and negative controls, then the flagged claim recomputed from its sweep
checks.result: 16 absence-claims found live. Most are descriptive or definitional; two state their own bound in the sentence ('even in forty cycles', 'within its working life'), which is the honest form. The one that did not state its domain - limbless-mouse 'below 0.31 the loop never engages' - was recomputed: threshold 0.307494, sweep covers s in [0.0, 2.0], threshold interior, and the region the claim names is covered to the end of the range. Not the boundary-artifact shape.
